result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both forms label every field and use selects and steppers for time, duration and boat counts. B wins narrowly because its numbered section headings (When, Your boats, Who's booking) group related fields more clearly. A does better on telling required and optional fields apart, since it says that all fields are required unless marked optional. Both screenshots end before the submit button and any total, so items 4 and 5 are scored only on what is visible, from the per-hour rates shown. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both forms label every field and use selects and steppers for time, duration and boat counts. A groups its fields more clearly, with numbered headings (When, Your boats, Who's booking) and good spacing. B has no group headings and leaves the 'How long' select alone at half width, though it does say up front that all fields are required unless marked optional, which A does not show. Neither screenshot shows the submit button or a running total, so item 5 can't be checked and is scored low for both.
